## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A four-*juan* late-Míng commentary on Huìsī's *Dàshèng zhǐguān fǎmén* ([KR6d0152](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0152), T1924) by **Ǒuyì Zhìxù** 蕅益智旭 (1599–1655), one of the *Míngmò sìdà gāosēng* 明末四大高僧. The work is the principal late-Míng commentary on Huìsī's foundational meditation manual, complementing Liǎorán's Sòng *Zōngyuán jì* ([KR6d0153](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0153)).

**Abstract**

Zhìxù's *Shìyào* belongs to his late-Míng systematic Tiāntái pedagogical project, alongside his commentaries on the Lotus Sūtra ([KR6d0010](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0010), [KR6d0081](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0081), [KR6d0082](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0082)) and his other Tiāntái scholastic productions. The work integrates Huìsī's foundational meditation manual into Zhìxù's late-Míng Tiāntái-Pure Land synthetic apparatus, providing the standard late-Míng-and-Qīng accessible commentary on the work.

The composition is bracketed within Zhìxù's mature productive period c. 1641–1655.
